data.content_ref: inline:015994869366 depends on SRC_002: the adversarial-probe methodology for distinguishing checklist compliance from genuine reliability is circular if constructing an item where surface cues and causal structure diverge presupposes knowledge of that structure. If the probe's construction is itself circular, any single-evaluation reliability claim inherits that circularity and the distinction collapses. This is refuted if adversarial items can be constructed from surface-cue statistics alone, without presupposing the latent causal model.
